name: McMurdo Station (settlement centre point)
notes: Drawn only to show the distance and bearing between the station and Williams Field; the measured great-circle distance from this point to the Williams Field outline centroid is about 10.0 km, shorter than the 8-mile (12.9 km) road trip in NASA's diary because the road winds.

summary.plain: A single point marking McMurdo Station, the main US Antarctic base on Ross Island, about 10 kilometres west of the Williams Field balloon facility.
